projectDescription: Vortex IQ is an AI Operating System for ecommerce that connects your entire tech stack—commerce platforms, ad channels, payments, fulfilment, and more—to monitor KPIs, diagnose root causes, and execute fixes automatically.
keyFeatures: Nerve Centre: real-time KPI monitoring with 6,034 cards across 215 connectors
Vortex Mind: AI root-cause diagnostics with 7 OpenClaw report types
Ask Viq: plain-English conversational queries over live store data with Profile-scoped isolation
Actions: AI-powered store audit, SEO/GEO Domination Engine, and bulk content editing
Vortex Apps: staging, backup, rollback, multichannel OMS, and AI app builder
Vortex Memory: persistent knowledge base plus auto-archived Vortex Mind report runs
Cross-channel connector graph joining commerce, ads, payments, fulfilment, and analytics
Agency workspace support with multi-client management
publicApiSurface: Vortex Backup API (Shopify and BigCommerce backup and restore)
AI Agents API (A2A agent cards and protocols)
Ask Viq query interface (profile-scoped plain-English queries)
Nerve Centre KPI card data surface

Vortex Mind diagnostic reports (Payment Performance, Decline Recovery, Checkout Conversion Failure, Daily Revenue Leakage, Customer Recovery Opportunity, Google Ads Revenue Intelligence, Paid Traffic Waste)
Actions Kanban API (findings, statuses, automation rules)
CloudHub multichannel inventory and order management API
